company.name: Trov
company.description: Technology-driven insurance platform founded in 2012, originally focused on on-demand, item-level insurance and later pivoted to embedded insurance solutions for mobility, gig economy, and digital platforms (E5, E6, E7).

customers.primary_user: End consumers purchasing on-demand, item-level insurance via mobile app and users of partner platforms embedding insurance (E5, E12, E7)
customers.buyer: Partner platforms embedding insurance (B2B2C) and individual consumers depending on distribution channel (E6, E7)
customers.payer: End consumers paying premiums and/or partner platforms where insurance is embedded in digital experiences (E7, E6)
segments: Consumers seeking on-demand, item-level insurance (E5, E12)
Mobility platforms and gig-economy marketplaces integrating embedded insurance (E6, E7)
Digital platforms seeking to offer insurance as an integrated feature to users (E7)

business_model.value_proposition: On-demand, item-level insurance for consumers and embeddable insurance technology for partners to integrate insurance into digital experiences (E5, E12, E7)
business_model.revenue_model: Insurance premiums and revenue via partner integrations/embedded insurance arrangements (evidence indicates shift to embedded insurance partnerships) (E6, E7)
business_model.pricing_model: On-demand, item-level pricing for consumer policies and partner-negotiated pricing for embedded products (E12, E13, E6)
distribution_channels: Mobile app for direct on-demand insurance (E12)
Embedded integrations within partner platforms (mobility, gig apps, digital platforms) (E6, E7)
cost_drivers: Claims payouts and claims management (customer value chain includes claims stage) (E8)
Technology platform and partner integration costs (E7)
Underwriting and risk management (implicit in operating insurance products; evidence references insurance stages including purchase, onboarding, and claims) (E8)

incumbents: Traditional insurers offering annual, bundled policies (E13, E8)
substitutes: Annual bundled insurance policies (traditional coverage models) (E13)
